+def test_prioritized_identifier_deduplicates_isbns_and_asins() -> None:
+    first = PrioritizedIdentifier("9780747532699", priority=Priority.HIGH)
+    duplicate = PrioritizedIdentifier(
+        "9780747532699", stage_import=False, priority=Priority.LOW
+    )
+    asin = PrioritizedIdentifier("B06XYHVXVJ")
+
+    assert first == duplicate
+    assert len({first, duplicate, asin}) == 2
+    assert first != asin
+    assert first != "9780747532699"
+    assert PrioritizedISBN(isbn="9780747532699") == first
+
+
+def test_prioritized_identifier_serializes_all_fields() -> None:
+    item = PrioritizedIdentifier(
+        "B06XYHVXVJ",
+        stage_import=False,
+        priority=Priority.HIGH,
+        timestamp=datetime(2023, 8, 1, 12, 30),
+    )
+

+        "identifier": "B06XYHVXVJ",
+        "stage_import": False,
+        "priority": "HIGH",
+        "timestamp": "2023-08-01T12:30:00",
+    }
+
+
+def test_prioritized_identifier_queue_order() -> None:
+    earlier = datetime(2023, 8, 1, 12, 30)
+    later = datetime(2023, 8, 1, 12, 31)
+    items = [
+        PrioritizedIdentifier("B000000001", priority=Priority.LOW, timestamp=earlier),
+        PrioritizedIdentifier("B000000002", priority=Priority.HIGH, timestamp=later),
+        PrioritizedIdentifier("B000000003", priority=Priority.HIGH, timestamp=earlier),
+    ]
+
+    assert [item.identifier for item in sorted(items)] == [
+        "B000000003",
+        "B000000002",
+        "B000000001",
+    ]
+
